kimi-plugin-manifest.registration: /plugins marketplace add via lazykimi-plugin/marketplace.json (v2), then install the lazykimi plugin
kimi-plugin-manifest.notes: 16 inline hooks (./hooks/<script>.sh) and 6 inline mcpServers (python3 ./mcp/<server>/server.py); sessionStart.skill = lazy-init-deep; always-orchestrated MCP profile (no env plumbing on this route).

project-init-route.registration: lazykimi init + scripts/install-hooks.sh appending the 8 critical [[hooks]] TOML entries to ~/.kimi-code/config.toml + project .kimi-code/mcp.json
project-init-route.notes: The remaining 8 advisory hook events activate only through the plugin manifest route; init rewrites __KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT__ to absolute paths and injects the MCP mode env stanza.

kimi-work-skills-fallback.notes: Kimi Work has no plugin manifest support: no commands, no agents, no hooks, no sessionStart.skill; lazykimi-* MCP servers are added manually one at a time through the Kimi Work MCP configuration UI.

payload.method: Deterministic inventory: walk each payload root (.kimi-code/skills, commands, agents, hooks, mcp) recursively from the plugin root; reject symlinks and non-regular files; skip entries named .gitkeep, __pycache__ directories, and .pyc bytecode; include only regular files with st_nlink == 1. Record {path, sha256} per file with the POSIX path relative to lazykimi-plugin and sha256 over the file bytes. Append policy.files entries the same way. Sort records byte-wise (Buffer.compare) by path. file_count is the record count; inventory_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON serialization of the sorted record array (JSON.stringify with default separators, no whitespace, insertion order = sorted path order). counts are derived from the canonical trees (skill directories, command markdown files, agent markdown files, hook scripts, mcp server directories) — never hand-maintained.
